title: On Playing the old air on the fiddle
subtitle: 戏剧表演 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）
meta: 主题语境：戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）　|　核心词汇：play　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 play 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the driver ① played the old air on the fiddle in silence, and every passenger in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the driver ② plays the old air on the fiddle twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ play the old air on the fiddle at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ played the old air on the fiddle before — a line in the timetable for February 1982 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Playing the old air on the fiddle in silence, the driver said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ play the king in the pageant twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Play the king in the pageant at once and never mention it again.

By 1995 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the timetable, and a new passenger from the next station ⑧ plays the king in the pageant in silence every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the platform, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ played the old air on the fiddle again when nobody else would.

⑩ To play the old air on the fiddle, my mother said in 2000, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody plays the old air on the fiddle twice over again and somebody must play the old air on the fiddle in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 演奏（一般过去式 played the old air on the fiddle：1988 年司机头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 演奏（一般现在 plays the old air on the fiddle：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 演奏（不定式 to play the old air on the fiddle：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 演奏（过去完成时 had played the old air on the fiddle：1982 年二月的时刻表上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 演奏（动名词 playing the old air on the fiddle 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 扮演（play the king in the pageant：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去扮演节庆戏里那位国王）
G. v. 扮演（play the king in the pageant：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 演奏（后段两处：新来的乘客照例 plays the king in the pageant，而母亲又一次 played the old air on the fiddle）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 play 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1988 the driver played the old air on the fiddle in silence, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the driver plays the old air on the fiddle twice over whenever the station asks.
Playing the old air on the fiddle in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever play the king in the pageant twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new passenger from the next station plays the king in the pageant in silence every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother played the old air on the fiddle again, and the station remembered that half.
